faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled-in application form is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted online before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MSc or MTech in Remote Sensing or Geoinformatics, MTech in Water Resources Engineering, MSc Geography with a relevant thesis, or any Masters Degree with SAR Imagery Processing Expertise. NET/GATE qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST, women, PwD, and OBC NCL candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of ₹37,000/- per month, plus 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. How is the selection process conducted for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit and project requirements, followed by an interview, which can be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of this job at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: This is a project-based position. The appointment is initially for 12 months and may be extended based on the candidate's performance and the project's needs.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all regions are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified educational qualifications and other eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be uploaded with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to upload scanned copies of their certificates, mark sheets, and other relevant documents along with their application form. A photograph and signature are also mandatory.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link are available on the IIT Jammu website. You can find direct links in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
